original.statement: gRPC-Web middleware is added to Traefik in version 3.0.0, providing support for gRPC-Web protocol handling.

decision.reason: [ev-83cbbcabe1b7] only records, under Enhancements, that a new gRPC-Web middleware was added. It names no environment state in which an existing deployment is affected. The proposed exposure, product-version traefik >=3.0.0, would flag every environment upgrading to 3.0.0, which is broader than any real exposure, and it misuses product-version (meant for another product) to point at Traefik itself. No exposure condition grounded in the evidence can be built for this opt-in addition: naming the middleware's config field would mean guessing a field the evidence doesn't give.
